purpose: Invite a group to commit to a shared action.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V volitional + ではないか / じゃないか
Let us first listen to the other person’s side.
Let us begin with what we can do.
Let us think it through together once more.
formation: V volitional + ではないか / じゃないか
register: Formal or rhetorical; じゃないか is conversational
restrictions: The よう in the reference label belongs to the volitional verb form.
mistake: Do not add よう after an already volitional form.
